en: Genesis 46

p.src: 1  Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

ja: イスラエルは自分のすべての持ち物と共に
にいけにえをささげた。
en: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
u.src: 1  Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

p.src: 2  God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

ja: は答えた。「ここにおります。」
en: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
u.src: 2  God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

p.src: 3  He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

ja: れるな。そこで、わたしはあなたを
en: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
u.src: 3  He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

p.src: 4  I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

ja: わたし自身があなたと
る。ヨセフの手があなたの
en: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

zh: 46:4 原文是將手按在你的眼睛上

p.src: 5  Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

u.src: 5  Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

p.src: 6  They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

en: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

p.src: 8  These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

ja: のとおりである。ヤコブの
en: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

p.src: 9  The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

ja: たちは、ハノク、パル、ヘツロン、カルミ。
en: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
u.src: 9  The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

p.src: 10  The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

ja: たちは、エムエル、ヤミン、オハデ、ヤキン、ツォハル、そしてカナン人の
en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
u.src: 11  The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

p.src: 12  The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

ja: たちは、エル、オナン、シェラ、ペレツ、ゼラ。しかし、エルとオナンはカナンの
たちはヘツロンとハムルであった。
en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

たちは、ヘベルとマルキエル。

en: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
